This editorial illustration shows two men in profile facing each other against a vast, yellow-brown field under a blue-to-pink gradient sky. Both men have dark hair and wear light blue button-down shirts and dark trousers. The man on the left wears glasses and a dark goatee, holding a coiled rope in his hands. The man on the right holds a rope lasso high over his head. Between them, in the lower center, a dark gray buffalo lies on the ground, its head turned towards the viewer. 

The title "TEMPO" is centered at the top in large, white, serif block letters. Above it, text reads "Tumpukan Masalah Sampah Kota H.94" and "Mengharap Tuah Khofifah H.32." Centered black text below the title reads "BEREBUT DAGING KERBAU INDIA," followed by a smaller paragraph beginning with "Mendapat hak monopoli, Perum Bulog..." and ending with "H.80." 

In the bottom right corner, a barcode, a QR code, the date "27 FEBRUARI-5 MARET 2023," "RP 50.000," and "MAJALAH.TEMPO.CO" are visible. The illustration style features visible brushstrokes and dramatic lighting, casting long shadows on the figures and the landscape.
